Fenn & Fable.rules:
Check the current window before sending.
Email a short query and attach a one-page synopsis and the first three chapters together as a single Word or PDF document.

Dzanc Books.rules:
Check the current submission window.
Submit the complete manuscript, synopsis, and brief author bio through Submittable.
Previously self-published work and writing created with generative AI assistance are ineligible. Genre fiction, children's books, and YA are excluded from general submissions.

Baen Books.rules: Science fiction and fantasy only. Complete manuscripts with a synopsis are preferred. Check the current upload format on the official submission page.
Baen Books.reason: Confirm the required upload format before building.

Angry Robot.rules: The standard route is through an agent. Check the official page for exceptions and designated unagented windows.
Angry Robot.reason: Requirements depend on the submission route or open call.

Tor Publishing Group.rules: Tor Publishing Group requires an agent for manuscripts and queries.
Tor Publishing Group.reason: Agent required. There is no direct author submission packet.

Graywolf Press.reason: Check the official page for program-specific eligibility and windows.

Asteria Press.reason: The cover sheet has publisher-specific requirements. Review them before building.
